headline: Chevron Explores Sale of Older U.S. Gulf Oil and Gas Assets
summary: Chevron is exploring the sale of some of its older oil and gas assets in the U.S. Gulf as part of a strategy to sharpen its operational focus.
why: Asset divestitures by major energy companies alter their capital expenditure profiles and portfolio cash generation capabilities.
